name: Halli Galli

categories.label: Cards held at game end (draw deck + face-up pile)
categories.labelVi: Tổng số bài còn giữ khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Count the draw deck plus the face-up discard pile. Most cards wins.

endCondition.description: Game ends when only 2 players remain and one of them wins the face-up piles (or the other rings by mistake)

notes: family: speed-reaction-card-collection. Players start with an equal share of 56 cards; first to ring when exactly 5 identical fruits show wins all face-up piles; wrong ring = give 1 card to each other player. Rulebook says only that the player with the most cards wins; no tiebreak stated. Players may optionally play on until one holds all cards.
